steps.en: Put a model key in backend/.env, start the backend and the frontend
steps.zh: 把模型 key 写进 backend/.env，启动后端和前端
steps.code: poetry run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 7001 · pnpm dev

steps.en: Drop in a screenshot and pick a stack (HTML + Tailwind, React, Vue…)
steps.zh: 拖进一张截图，选技术栈（HTML + Tailwind、React、Vue 等）

steps.en: Runs four model variants in parallel, each an agent writing one HTML file
steps.zh: 并行跑四个模型版本，每个都是写单个 HTML 文件的 agent

steps.en: Crops the real logos and images out of your screenshot by bounding box
steps.zh: 按定位框从你的截图里裁出真实的 logo 和图片

steps.en: Renders its page in headless Chromium, compares the shots by eye, patches the gaps
steps.zh: 用无头 Chromium 渲染自己的页面，目测对比后修补差异

steps.en: Pick the closest variant, refine a clicked element, export
steps.zh: 挑最像的版本，点选元素提修改，导出

value.en: A runnable single-file replica with your real images — no hand-slicing the layout or the assets
value.zh: 拿到一份带真实图片、能直接打开的单文件复刻页——不用手工切图、手写布局
